zh.name: 内容工具

zh.name: 运行中引导

zh.name: 控制工具

en.name: Delivery tools

en.name: User database tools

zh.name: 用户数据库工具
zh.description: 追踪、搜索、更新与删除持久实体。

en.name: Extension tools
en.description: Inspect and manage external integrations and runtime environments.

zh.name: 扩展工具
zh.description: 检查并管理外部集成与运行环境。

zh.name: 对话目标

zh.description: 识别 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 项目并提供对应的工作区动作。

en.description: Detect TeX projects and contribute document build and preview actions.

zh.description: 识别 Go 模块并提供对应的工作区动作。

en.description: Detect Java build systems and contribute their workspace actions.

zh.description: 识别 Cargo 项目并提供对应的工作区动作。

en.name: GitHub projects
en.description: Detect GitHub repositories and contribute repository workspace actions.

zh.name: GitHub 项目
zh.description: 识别 GitHub 仓库并提供仓库工作区动作。

en.name: Make projects
en.description: Detect Makefiles and contribute declared build targets as workspace actions.

zh.name: Make 项目
zh.description: 识别 Makefile 并将已声明的构建目标提供为工作区动作。

en.name: Visible split context
en.description: Tell the Agent which panes are currently visible beside the active conversation.

zh.name: 当前分屏上下文
zh.description: 每轮自动告诉 Agent 当前对话旁边可见的分屏。

en.name: CLI Plugins
en.description: Install CLI tools and connect approved commands through tree-local Hooks.

zh.name: CLI 插件
zh.description: 安装命令行工具，并通过树级 Hook 接入已批准的命令。

en.name: Image tools
en.description: Generate image assets and attach their results.

zh.name: 图片工具
zh.description: 生成图片资源并附加结果。

en.name: Knowledge tools
en.description: Search, manage, index, and present project knowledge and library documents.

zh.name: 知识工具
zh.description: 搜索、管理、索引并呈现项目知识与文献库文档。

en.name: Map tools
en.description: Search places and calculate map routes.

zh.name: 地图工具
zh.description: 搜索地点并计算地图路线。

en.name: MCP services
en.description: Connect and load tools provided by MCP services.

zh.name: MCP 服务
zh.description: 连接并加载 MCP 服务提供的工具。

en.name: Media tools
en.description: Start asynchronous media generation.

zh.name: 媒体工具
zh.description: 启动异步媒体生成。

en.name: Memory tools
en.description: Inject, learn, recall, save, search, and retire memories.

zh.name: 记忆工具
zh.description: 注入、学习、召回、保存、搜索与淘汰记忆。

en.name: Model tools
en.description: Provide and route configurable model connections.

zh.name: 模型工具
zh.description: 提供并路由可配置的模型连接。

en.name: Microsoft Office tools
en.description: Inspect, edit, render, and compose PowerPoint presentations.

zh.name: Microsoft Office 工具
zh.description: 检查、编辑、渲染并创作 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

en.name: Plugin development
en.description: Create, validate, install, and reload editable Cyrene PluginPacks.

zh.name: 插件开发
zh.description: 创建、验证、安装并重载可编辑的 Cyrene PluginPack。

en.name: Proactive Agent
en.description: Run optional proactive Agent work in the background.

zh.name: 主动 Agent
zh.description: 在后台按策略执行可选的主动 Agent 工作。

en.name: Remote Cyrene tools
en.description: Operate explicitly selected paired Cyrene devices.

zh.name: 远程 Cyrene 工具
zh.description: 操作明确选中的已配对 Cyrene 设备。

en.name: Renderer tools
en.description: Load Workbench renderer contracts.

zh.name: 渲染工具
zh.description: 加载 Workbench 渲染契约。

en.name: Schedule tools
en.description: Create, manage, execute, and inspect durable scheduled tasks.

zh.name: 日程工具
zh.description: 创建、管理、执行并检查持久定时任务。

en.name: Skill tools
en.description: Install, inspect, load, and run Cyrene skills.

zh.name: 技能工具
zh.description: 安装、检查、加载并运行 Cyrene Skill。

en.name: Soul
en.description: Mount the enabled SOUL.md persona directly below the system prompt.

zh.name: 灵魂
zh.description: 启用后，将 SOUL.md 人格挂载到系统提示词正下方。

en.name: Subagent tools
en.description: Spawn and coordinate Cyrene subagents.

zh.name: 子 Agent 工具
zh.description: 创建并协调 Cyrene 子 Agent。

en.name: System prompt
en.description: Mount the base Agent instructions at the start of system context.

zh.name: 系统提示词
zh.description: 在系统上下文最前方挂载 Agent 的基础指令。

en.name: Voice
en.description: Provide speech recognition, synthesis, and voice settings.

zh.name: 语音
zh.description: 提供语音识别、语音合成与声音设置。

en.name: AMD GPU Cloud
en.description: Call AMD GPU Cloud and discover the models available to its configured connection.

zh.name: AMD GPU Cloud
zh.description: 调用已配置的 AMD GPU Cloud 连接，并发现该连接可用的模型。

en.name: Analyze attachment
en.description: Analyze an uploaded attachment or workspace file. PDFs and Office documents (DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, including extensionless uploads) are parsed to text locally. Images run downloaded local PP-OCRv6 first, then fall back to vision when text is insufficient or the prompt needs visual understanding. Use the exact path returned by ListKnowledgeDocuments for knowledge-base files.

zh.name: 分析附件
zh.description: 分析上传的附件或工作区文件；本地解析文档，并对图片执行 OCR 或视觉理解。

en.name: Anthropic
en.description: Call Anthropic and discover the models available to its configured connection.

zh.name: Anthropic
zh.description: 调用已配置的 Anthropic 连接，并发现该连接可用的模型。

en.name: Click application component
en.description: Invoke, select, or toggle an action declared by an external application's accessibility tree. Uses only leased accessibility-tree node/action IDs; coordinates, selectors, scripts, and focus changes are forbidden.

zh.name: 点击应用组件
zh.description: 通过外部应用的可访问性树执行点击、选择或切换操作，仅使用租约节点与动作标识。

en.name: Double-click application component
en.description: Invoke a native double-click action only when the accessibility provider explicitly exposes one. Uses only leased accessibility-tree node/action IDs; coordinates, selectors, scripts, and focus changes are forbidden.

zh.name: 双击应用组件
zh.description: 仅在外部应用的可访问性提供程序明确支持时执行原生双击。

en.name: Drag application component
en.description: Invoke a native semantic drag, move, reorder, or resize action explicitly declared by the target node. Uses only leased accessibility-tree node/action IDs; coordinates, selectors, scripts, and focus changes are forbidden.

zh.name: 拖动应用组件
zh.description: 对外部应用明确声明的节点执行语义化拖动、移动、重排或缩放。

en.name: Inspect application component
en.description: Inspect a leased external-app accessibility node and its next semantic layer without screenshots or focus.

zh.name: 检查应用组件
zh.description: 检查外部应用中已租用的可访问性节点及其下一层语义结构。

en.name: Scroll application component
en.description: Invoke a semantic scroll action declared by an accessible container. Uses only leased accessibility-tree node/action IDs; coordinates, selectors, scripts, and focus changes are forbidden.

zh.name: 滚动应用组件
zh.description: 调用外部应用可访问容器所声明的语义滚动操作。

en.name: Snapshot application interface
en.description: Discover targets, connect a semantic-only application session, read or reprobe the paginated current accessibility layer, find nodes by role, name, or text criteria, report status, or disconnect. Use AppUIInspect to descend from a returned node. Never captures pixels or changes focus.

zh.name: 快照应用界面
zh.description: 发现外部应用目标并读取分页的可访问性语义树，不截屏也不改变焦点。

en.name: Type in application component
en.description: Set or append text through a native editable accessibility interface. Uses only leased accessibility-tree node/action IDs; coordinates, selectors, scripts, and focus changes are forbidden.

zh.name: 向应用组件输入
zh.description: 通过外部应用原生可编辑接口设置或追加文本。

en.name: Approve script
en.description: Approve a pending script so it may run.

zh.name: 审批脚本
zh.description: 批准待审脚本，使其可以执行。

en.name: Bash
en.description: Run a shell command in the workspace. Shell file-printing output does not satisfy a request to open or show a named file in the workspace UI.

zh.name: 执行命令
zh.description: 在工作区中运行 Shell 命令。Shell 打印出的文件内容不能替代在工作区界面中打开或显示指定文件。

en.name: Code review
en.description: Perform a comprehensive code review: runs linter, format check, and structural analysis (functions, classes, complexity, imports). Returns a report with issues and suggestions.

zh.name: 代码审查
zh.description: 运行静态检查、格式检查与结构分析，生成包含问题和建议的代码审查报告。

en.name: Codex OAuth
en.description: Call OpenAI Codex OAuth and discover the models available to its configured connection.

zh.name: Codex OAuth
zh.description: 调用已配置的 OpenAI Codex OAuth 连接，并发现该连接可用的模型。

en.name: Read Cyrene status
en.description: Read local Cyrene backend, settings-revision, host, current-surface and window status.

zh.name: 读取 Cyrene 状态
zh.description: 读取本机 Cyrene 后端、设置版本、宿主、当前界面与窗口状态。

en.name: Manage Cyrene chats
en.description: List, read, create, rename, compact, fork, group or delete Workbench conversations without sending a message as the user.

zh.name: 管理 Cyrene 对话
zh.description: 列出、读取、创建、重命名、压缩、分叉、分组或删除 Workbench 对话。

en.name: Manage Cyrene backups
en.description: List, create, validate, restore or delete Cyrene-owned backup archives by stable backup name.

zh.name: 管理 Cyrene 备份
zh.description: 按稳定备份名列出、创建、校验、恢复或删除 Cyrene 备份。

en.name: Control Cyrene lifecycle
en.description: Read, cancel or schedule a durable Cyrene restart/quit after the current reply is finalized.

zh.name: 控制 Cyrene 生命周期
zh.description: 读取、取消或安排在当前回复完成后持久重启或退出 Cyrene。

en.name: Manage Cyrene projects
en.description: List, read, create, update or delete local Cyrene projects through the Workbench repository. Switching the visible project is available only through the current UI surface.

zh.name: 管理 Cyrene 项目
zh.description: 通过 Workbench 存储库列出、读取、创建、更新或删除本机项目。

en.name: Message another session
en.description: Put text in the composer shown in the exact current UI surface snapshot and dispatch it to that other conversation as an agent-originated message. It cannot submit the calling session's own composer.

zh.name: 向其他会话发送消息
zh.description: 向指定的另一对话编辑器填入文本并发送 Agent 来源消息。

en.name: Describe Cyrene settings
en.description: Describe agent-visible Cyrene settings, types, risks, limits and apply modes without reading secrets.

zh.name: 描述 Cyrene 设置
zh.description: 说明代理可见设置的类型、风险、限制与应用方式，不读取密钥。

en.name: Read Cyrene settings
en.description: Read public or masked values from one Cyrene settings namespace.

zh.name: 读取 Cyrene 设置
zh.description: 读取一个 Cyrene 设置命名空间中的公开值或脱敏值。

en.name: Update Cyrene settings
en.description: Atomically patch one typed Cyrene settings namespace with revision/CAS protection. Shortcut maps preserve unspecified actions; use null only to reset an explicitly named action.

zh.name: 修改 Cyrene 设置
zh.description: 在版本保护下原子更新一个类型化的 Cyrene 设置命名空间。

en.name: Click interface component
en.description: Click, toggle, open a context menu, or dismiss a currently declared Cyrene component action by stable node and action IDs; never uses coordinates or focus.

zh.name: 点击界面组件
zh.description: 按稳定节点和动作标识点击、切换、打开菜单或关闭当前 Cyrene 组件动作。

en.name: Double-click interface component
en.description: Double-click a currently declared Cyrene component action by stable node and action IDs. The action must explicitly advertise a double-click gesture; never uses coordinates or focus.

zh.name: 双击界面组件
zh.description: 仅对明确声明双击手势的 Cyrene 组件执行双击。

en.name: Drag interface component
en.description: Drag, reorder, move, or resize through a currently declared Cyrene semantic action by stable node and action IDs; never accepts raw coordinates.

zh.name: 拖动界面组件
zh.description: 通过稳定语义动作拖动、重排、移动或缩放 Cyrene 组件。

en.name: Inspect interface component
en.description: Inspect one component selected from a Cyrene UI snapshot. Unrelated UI changes do not invalidate its node lease; the target's own semantic change does. Returns state, declared gestures, expected outcomes, and a paginated child subtree without performing the action.

zh.name: 检查界面组件
zh.description: 检查 Cyrene 快照中的组件状态、可用手势、预期结果与分页子树。

en.name: Scroll interface component
en.description: Scroll a currently declared Cyrene viewport or list action by stable node and action IDs; does not depend on pointer position or focus.

zh.name: 滚动界面组件
zh.description: 按稳定节点和动作标识滚动当前 Cyrene 视口或列表。

en.name: Snapshot current interface
en.description: Snapshot the current Cyrene UI layer as a structured, paginated semantic component tree. This is read-only and does not activate or focus the app.

zh.name: 快照当前界面
zh.description: 以结构化分页语义树读取当前 Cyrene 界面，不激活应用或改变焦点。

en.name: Type in interface component
en.description: Type or select a value through a currently declared Cyrene component action by stable node and action IDs; does not depend on keyboard focus.

zh.name: 向界面组件输入
zh.description: 通过当前声明的 Cyrene 组件动作输入文本或选择值。

en.name: Manage Cyrene updates
en.description: Check update status, download a checksum-pinned package, or schedule verified installation after reply finalization.

zh.name: 管理 Cyrene 更新
zh.description: 检查更新、下载经过校验和固定的软件包，或安排回复完成后安装。

en.name: Control Cyrene window
en.description: Inspect or change only the window bound to this run's current Cyrene surface.

zh.name: 控制 Cyrene 窗口
zh.description: 检查或更改当前运行界面所绑定的 Cyrene 窗口。

en.name: Workspace action
en.description: Discover or run project-defined Build, Run, Test, and Preview actions. Prefer this over constructing shell commands when a matching action exists. Local build/test actions may be retried inside a Goal; deployment and publishing are intentionally unsupported.

zh.name: 工作区动作
zh.description: 发现或运行项目插件定义的构建、启动、测试与预览动作。

en.name: Deep reflection
en.description: Main agent only. Reframe the next working context when the current approach is not satisfying the user's goal, repeated work is not converging, or user guidance shows the direction is wrong. Do not use this merely because one tool failed. The visible transcript is preserved; future LLM context uses a compressed reflection packet. Call this as the only tool in its tool-call turn; after it completes, continue automatically from the rewritten context.

zh.name: 深度反思
zh.description: 当当前方法无法收敛时，为主代理重构下一阶段工作上下文。

en.name: DeepSeek
en.description: Call DeepSeek and discover the models available to its configured connection.

zh.name: DeepSeek
zh.description: 调用已配置的 DeepSeek 连接，并发现该连接可用的模型。

en.name: Delete terminal
en.description: Permanently terminate and delete a terminal created by the Agent in this conversation. Ask the user and wait for confirmation before calling. Deletion cancels any pending wake. If multiple terminal panes are visible and no identifier is provided, ask which terminal to use.

zh.name: 删除终端
zh.description: 永久终止并删除本对话中由代理创建的终端。

en.name: Edit
en.description: Replace an exact string in a text file.

zh.name: 编辑文件
zh.description: 替换文本文件中的精确字符串。

en.name: Find references
en.description: Find all call sites that reference a given function or method name (partial match). Shows the caller, target, file, and line number. Results capped at 100. Requires IndexCodebase to have been run first.

zh.name: 查找引用
zh.description: 在代码索引中查找函数或方法的所有调用位置。

en.name: Format code
en.description: Run the Ruff formatter on a file or directory. Use check_only=True to see what would change without actually modifying files.

zh.name: 代码格式化
zh.description: 使用 Ruff 格式化文件或目录，也可仅检查而不修改。

en.name: GLM
en.description: Call GLM and discover the models available to its configured connection.

zh.name: GLM
zh.description: 调用已配置的 GLM 连接，并发现该连接可用的模型。

en.name: Gemini
en.description: Call Gemini and discover the models available to its configured connection.

zh.name: Gemini
zh.description: 调用已配置的 Gemini 连接，并发现该连接可用的模型。

en.name: Generate image
en.description: Main agent only. Generate one image through the active OpenAI OAuth account and deliver it directly to the current WebUI conversation. Use this for requests to draw, render, create, or generate a raster image. This tool is unavailable to custom OpenAI-compatible/API Key models.

zh.name: 生成图片
zh.description: 通过当前 OpenAI OAuth 账户生成一张图片并交付到当前对话。

en.name: File symbols
en.description: Get all symbols (functions, classes, methods) defined in a specific file with their signatures and docstrings. Quick structural overview without reading the entire file. Requires IndexCodebase to have been run first.

zh.name: 获取文件符号
zh.description: 从代码索引读取指定文件定义的函数、类、方法、签名与文档字符串。

en.name: View learned skill
en.description: View the full details of an auto-learned skill by name. Returns the skill's description, trigger pattern, steps, input schema, and run statistics.

zh.name: 查看自动技能
zh.description: 按名称查看自动学习技能的说明、触发模式、步骤、输入结构与运行统计。

en.name: Git branch
en.description: List local branches or create a new one. Pass create='name' to create a new branch.

zh.name: Git 分支
zh.description: 列出本地 Git 分支或创建新分支。

en.name: Git commit
en.description: Stage and commit changes. Requires user confirmation before committing. Use this to save work with a descriptive message.

zh.name: Git 提交
zh.description: 暂存并提交更改；提交前需要用户确认。

en.name: Git diff
en.description: Show changes in the working tree. Use staged=True to see staged changes. Use path to limit to a specific file.

zh.name: Git 差异
zh.description: 显示工作树或暂存区差异，并可限定到指定路径。

en.name: Git log
en.description: Show recent commit history. Returns commit hashes and messages.

zh.name: Git 历史
zh.description: 显示最近的 Git 提交历史、哈希与消息。

en.name: Git status
en.description: Show the working tree status. Returns a list of changed files with their status (M=modified, A=added, D=deleted, ??=untracked) and whether each is staged.

zh.name: Git 状态
zh.description: 显示工作树文件状态及其是否已暂存。

en.name: Find files
en.description: Find files in the workspace using a glob pattern.

zh.name: 查找文件
zh.description: 使用 Glob 模式查找工作区文件。

en.name: Search
en.description: Search file contents by regex pattern inside the workspace.

zh.name: 搜索内容
zh.description: 使用正则表达式搜索工作区文件内容。

en.name: Index codebase
en.description: Build or update the code index for the project. Scans Python files and extracts symbols (functions, classes, methods), call-graph references, and imports into a SQLite database. Use this before SearchSymbol/FindReferences/GetFileSymbols. Use force=True to rebuild from scratch and clean stale entries.

zh.name: 索引代码库
zh.description: 扫描 Python 代码并建立包含符号、调用关系与导入的 SQLite 索引。

en.name: Install skill
en.description: Install an external skill from a local path. Supports .md / .txt / .prompt / .json / .yaml / .yml files, directories containing SKILL.md, and .zip archives. zh.description: 读取已授权终端的当前屏幕、回滚历史、命令或命令输出。

en.name: Recall conversation

zh.name: 回忆历史对话

en.name: Recall memory

zh.description: 调用远程设备上获准的 Plugin 工具包。

en.name: Run learned skill
en.description: Execute an auto-learned skill by name. Runs all its steps (tool calls) with optional parameter overrides and returns the results from each step. Increments the skill's run counter. Only skills without high-risk steps (shell commands, file writes) can be executed.

zh.name: 运行远程 Cyrene
zh.description: 在明确选择的已配对设备上运行远程 Cyrene 请求。

en.name: Search skills
en.description: Search enabled external Skills by ID, name, full description, and tags. Use this when the relevant Skill is not already obvious from the injected catalog. Returns metadata only; call LoadSkill before following a Skill.

en.description: Send text or a terminal key to an authorized shared terminal. Without shell_id or name, automatically use the single terminal currently visible in the active split, even when it is not bound to the conversation. User input has priority and non-owned terminals require explicit user authorization. If multiple terminal panes are visible, ask which terminal to use.

zh.name: 执行命令
zh.description: 向已授权终端发送命令，并可等待完成或安排退出唤醒。

en.name: Show terminal
en.description: Show an authorized terminal in a split. Creates a split when only one pane is open; otherwise replaces one existing pane. Use only when the user explicitly asks to open or show it. If multiple terminal panes are visible and no identifier is provided, ask which terminal to use.

zh.name: 显示终端
zh.description: 按用户明确要求在分屏中显示已授权终端。

en.name: Generate media
en.description: Main agent only. Submit 1-8 image, video, or music generation jobs to the independent media daemon and return immediately. Successful outputs are attached directly to the current chat, then one internal wake resumes the Agent after every job in the batch is terminal. After submission, end the turn immediately and never poll, wait, or start a terminal watcher.

zh.description: 向独立媒体守护进程提交图片、视频或音乐生成任务。

en.name: Open shell
en.description: Create a conversation-bound terminal in the Cyrene Terminal Daemon. It appears in the terminal list but does not replace the user's current view. With wake_on_exit and a local initial command, the command runs as a durable one-shot job and wakes this conversation after exit.

zh.name: 开启终端
zh.description: 创建绑定到当前对话的 Cyrene 终端会话。

en.name: App Use
en.description: Purely visual desktop control for macOS or Windows. This scheme uses window captures, calibrated coordinates, OS pointer/keyboard input, and visual effect checks; it never reads or invokes an accessibility tree. Start with operation='list_targets', then operation='connect'. Connect is always mode='visual' and returns the runtime visual capabilities for that window. Invoke a disclosed capability with operation='call'. For a named target, call visual_describe, inspect the fresh screenshot, and call measure_coordinates with the selected captured-image point. Inspect the marked crop, then pass the returned window_point unchanged. Use focus_window followed by click_at as the primary activation path; visual_click may re-localize visually after a definite pre-action failure. Coordinate input may visibly move the real cursor or temporarily change focus, and every dispatched action must be verified. This tool never invokes semantic refs, AX/UIA actions, or accessibility-tree fallbacks. If the visual scheme produces a hard failure before dispatching input, disconnect it and explicitly start AppUISnapshot as a separate semantic session. For a visible macOS text input, visual_type keeps capture localization, PID-targeted coordinate input, and exact-text verification in one visual operation. Use low-level virtual_type_at only when current visual evidence already supplies coordinates. If visual_type returns unsupported_background_text_input with isolation_required=true, do not retry or ask to take over the user's foreground; report that a separate desktop/VM worker must be configured. Reconnect when a visual session becomes stale.

en.name: Ask user
en.description: Ask the user a clarification question and pause until they answer. Use this liberally — asking is better than assuming. Trigger when: the request is ambiguous, details are missing, multiple reasonable approaches exist, or you need sign-off before a risky action. If you need to ask the user anything, use this tool instead of putting a question in assistant text. Use freeform text for open questions, or add a short options array for structured choices. The UI always allows custom answers even with options.

zh.name: 网络日志

en.name: Request control

zh.name: 滚动页面

en.name: Inspect page

zh.name: 检查页面
zh.description: 检查当前页面并返回可操作元素的引用、文本、链接与边界。

en.name: Close tab

zh.name: 关闭浏览器标签页
zh.description: 按标签标识关闭嵌入式浏览器标签页，未指定时关闭当前页。

en.name: List tabs

zh.name: 列出浏览器标签页
zh.description: 列出嵌入式浏览器标签页及其网址、标题和加载状态。

en.name: New tab
en.description: Open a new tab (only when the user explicitly asks to keep a page open while browsing something else). After this, browser_navigate will navigate the NEW tab. Do NOT call this just to visit a different URL — reuse the same tab with browser_navigate instead.

zh.name: 新建浏览器标签页
zh.description: 仅在用户明确要求保留当前页面时新建浏览器标签页。

en.name: Select tab

zh.name: 选择浏览器标签页
zh.description: 按标签标识选择已有嵌入式浏览器标签页。

en.name: Type

zh.name: 浏览器输入
zh.description: 向当前网页的输入元素键入文本，并可按回车提交。

en.name: Type ref
en.description: Type text into an editable element returned by browser_snapshot using its ref.

zh.name: 输入引用元素
zh.description: 使用页面快照引用向可编辑元素键入文本。

en.name: Upload files
en.description: Attach local files to a browser file input without opening the system file picker. Use chooser_id returned by an intercepted browser click, or use the ref of a visible input[type=file] from browser_snapshot. The host reviews the exact tool call before execution; this tool binds the destination, input, filenames, sizes, and hashes. It never submits a separate form button.

zh.name: 上传文件
zh.description: 将本地文件附加到网页文件输入框，不打开系统文件选择器。

en.name: User browser operations
en.description: List recent user-driven operations in the embedded browser for the current chat session, including clicks, text input, scrolling, and navigation.

zh.name: 用户浏览器操作
zh.description: 列出当前对话最近的用户浏览器点击、输入、滚动与导航记录。

en.name: Wait page
en.description: Last-resort conditional wait for a specific selector, text, or URL after SPA rendering. Do not use it to delay for a fixed amount of time; prefer an immediate browser_snapshot or browser_network_log, and rely on the Workbench inbox to wake the agent for tool results.

zh.name: 等待页面
zh.description: 在单页应用渲染后等待特定选择器、文本或网址条件。

en.name: Connect pins
en.description: Connect two existing named map pins with an optional travel mode and Markdown note.

zh.name: 连接标记
zh.description: 连接两个已有的具名地图标记，可选交通方式和 Markdown 备注。

en.name: Decide
en.description: Return the permission decision. Call this tool exactly once.

zh.name: 决策
zh.description: 返回一次权限审查决定；该工具必须且只能调用一次。

en.name: Delete user data
en.description: Archive or permanently delete durable user data.

zh.name: 删除用户数据
zh.description: 归档或永久删除持久用户数据。

en.name: Enter plan mode
en.description: Main agent only. Enter PLAN MODE: decompose the user's request into ordered steps with explicit prerequisites and execution details, show the plan in the right sidebar's 计划 tab, and ask the user to approve / reject / revise before doing any real work. Use this proactively for complex, multi-step, or risky work where the user would benefit from reviewing the approach first. Do NOT combine with other tools in the same turn; calling this pauses the round for the user's decision.

zh.name: 进入计划模式
zh.description: 进入计划模式，分解任务并让用户审核后再执行。

en.name: Delete user data

zh.name: 删除用户数据

zh.name: 追踪用户数据
zh.description: 创建任务、项目、决定、事实、关系等持久事务。

en.name: Update user data
en.description: Update one entity field using a full ID, unique ID prefix, or exact title.

zh.name: 更新用户数据
zh.description: 按标识或精确标题更新一个持久事务字段。

en.name: List user data
en.description: List durable user data in the current project.

zh.name: 列出用户数据
zh.description: 列出当前项目中的持久用户数据。

en.name: Propose Goal
en.description: Propose a concrete Goal for the user to edit and confirm. Use only during a /goal discussion after understanding the request.

zh.name: 提出目标
zh.description: 在 /goal 讨论明确后，提出可供用户编辑并确认的目标。

en.name: Pin location
en.description: Pin a place on the map so it can be viewed and connected to other pins.

zh.name: 标记位置
zh.description: 在地图上标记地点，以便查看并与其他标记连接。

en.name: Finish subagent
en.description: Subagent-only terminal protocol. First write the complete result in normal assistant content, then call quit alone.

zh.name: 结束子代理
zh.description: 子代理完成协议：先输出完整结果，再单独调用 quit。

en.name: Query user data
en.description: Search durable user data in the current project.

zh.name: 查询用户数据
zh.description: 搜索当前项目中的持久用户数据。

en.name: Query round
en.description: Main agent only. List this session's subagents and status.

zh.name: 查询轮次
zh.description: 列出当前会话子代理及其状态。

en.name: Proactive heartbeat
en.description: Run one proactive Agent heartbeat. Hidden from models.

zh.name: 主动心跳
zh.description: 运行一次主动代理心跳；该工具对模型隐藏。

en.name: Read tool result
en.description: Read or search a previously truncated tool result using its tool-result:// content_ref. References are scoped to this session.

zh.name: 读取工具结果
zh.description: 通过内容引用读取或搜索先前被截断的工具结果。

en.name: Retire project memory
en.description: Mark one outdated memory in the current Workbench project as retired. Use the exact memory_id returned by search_project_memory. Retired memories remain visible and recoverable on the Memory page, but are excluded from future agent context and normal project-memory searches. Use this when you can identify a stale, incorrect, or superseded memory but are not saving a replacement fact. This does not permanently delete data.

zh.name: 停用项目记忆
zh.description: 将当前项目中过时的记忆标记为已停用，但保留以供审计和恢复。

en.name: Retire short-term memory
en.description: Mark one recent cross-session short-term memory as retired. Use the exact memory_id returned by RecallMemory. Retired short-term memories remain in the local store for auditability, but are excluded from future memory context and RecallMemory results. Use this when the user says a recalled short-term memory is wrong, stale, or should no longer be used. This does not permanently delete data.

zh.name: 停用短期记忆
zh.description: 将错误或过时的短期记忆标记为已停用。

en.name: Save memory
en.description: Save a durable fact about THIS project into its long-term memory so future runs in this project automatically see and reuse it. Use proactively when you learn something worth remembering: a confirmed constraint or decision, a tool/approach that works, a dead-end to avoid, a key file or command, the user's stated preference, a recurring way they work or want you to collaborate (a working `habit` — record these actively; they are easy to miss), or an environment fact. Persistent and visible to the user on the project's Memory page. Do NOT use it for transient chit-chat, one-off run output, or secrets. Duplicates are merged automatically, and if this fact updates/contradicts an older memory (e.g. a changed value or a corrected conclusion) the outdated one is retired automatically — so always record your latest understanding without worrying about stale entries. Prefer writing prose in the user's configured language (Chinese UI/user → Chinese; English UI/user → English), while preserving code, paths, commands, identifiers, and proper nouns exactly.

zh.name: 保存记忆
zh.description: 保存可跨对话复用的项目事实、约束、决定、偏好或工作方法。

en.name: Cancel schedule
en.description: Cancel a running occurrence and permanently delete its scheduled task.

zh.name: 取消定时任务
zh.description: 取消正在运行的实例并永久删除对应定时任务。

en.name: Schedule task
en.description: Create an exact-message or Agent scheduled task in the current project.

zh.name: 创建定时任务
zh.description: 在当前项目创建精确消息或代理型定时任务。

en.name: Edit schedule
en.description: Partially edit one scheduled task; changed grants are reviewed again.

zh.name: 编辑定时任务
zh.description: 部分修改定时任务，并重新审查发生变化的权限。

en.name: List schedules
en.description: List scheduled tasks in the current project.

zh.name: 列出定时任务
zh.description: 列出当前项目中的定时任务。

en.name: List schedule occurrences
en.description: Expand scheduled tasks into calendar events for a requested time window.

zh.name: 查看任务执行时间
zh.description: 将定时任务展开为指定时间窗口内的日历事件。

en.name: Pause schedule
en.description: Pause a scheduled task and cancel its currently running occurrence.

zh.name: 暂停定时任务
zh.description: 暂停定时任务并取消其当前运行实例。

en.name: Resume schedule
en.description: Resume a paused scheduled task and calculate its next occurrence.

zh.name: 恢复定时任务
zh.description: 恢复已暂停的定时任务并计算下一次执行时间。

en.name: List schedule runs
en.description: List durable execution history for one scheduled task.

zh.name: 查看运行记录
zh.description: 列出一个定时任务的持久执行历史。

en.name: Run scheduler tick
en.description: Claim and execute due schedules. This host-triggered tool is hidden from models.

zh.name: 执行调度检查
zh.description: 领取并执行到期的定时任务；该工具对模型隐藏。

en.name: Search project memory
en.description: Search durable memory belonging to the current Workbench project using keyword and phrase substring matching. This is not semantic or vector search and does not use embeddings. Use this for prior project decisions, constraints, working approaches, user preferences, or environment facts that may not be present in the automatically injected memory subset. Read-only; only works inside a Workbench project task or chat.

zh.name: 搜索项目记忆
zh.description: 使用关键词和短语子串搜索当前项目的持久记忆。

en.name: Skill learning worker
en.description: Process pending behavior-learning turns. Hidden from models.

zh.name: 技能学习任务
zh.description: 处理等待中的行为学习轮次；该工具对模型隐藏。

en.name: Agent message
en.description: Send a message to the main agent or another subagent through the session-scoped inbox.

zh.name: 发送代理消息
zh.description: 通过会话收件箱向主代理或另一子代理发送消息。

en.name: Send file
en.description: Main agent only. Deliver a file you actually created as a downloadable artifact. The file must exist; never guess paths or merely print one in chat. If the user requests a specific save location, save the file there first, then call this tool, including for authorized paths outside the workspace. This tool does not save or move files.

zh.name: 发送文件
zh.description: 将实际创建且存在的文件作为可下载附件交付给用户。

en.name: Send message
en.description: Main agent only. Send a brief user-visible mid-run reply in the current chat. For tool-using work this MUST be the first call in the first execution batch, immediately followed by the first useful tool call in the same batch whenever safe. Never use this for subagent coordination or subagent final delivery.

zh.name: 发送消息
zh.description: 在当前对话中发送简短、用户可见的执行中进度消息。

en.name: Message user
en.description: Reply directly to the user. Only available when the user has @mentioned you directly. Use this to respond to the user's direct message. Not for normal rounds — return the final response normally.

zh.name: 向用户发送消息
zh.description: 在用户直接提及时向其发送回复。

en.name: Notify
en.description: Send a desktop or webhook notification. Use for alerts, reminders, or when you need the user's attention outside the chat. Supports Telegram and WeChat if configured.

zh.name: 发送通知
zh.description: 发送桌面或 Webhook 通知，并可使用已配置的 Telegram 或微信通道。

en.name: Send Telegram
en.description: Send a Telegram message to the user. NOT for agent-to-agent communication — use send_agent_message instead.

zh.name: 发送 Telegram
zh.description: 通过 Telegram 向用户发送消息。

en.name: Send WeChat file
en.description: Send a file you have CREATED to the user via WeChat. Only works when the current conversation is on the WeChat channel — files are encrypted with AES-128-ECB and uploaded to CDN. A delivery notice appears in the WebUI chat history.

zh.name: 发送微信文件
zh.description: 在微信通道中加密上传并发送代理创建的文件。

en.name: Start subagent
en.description: Main agent only. Spawn an independent execution worker or a bounded discussion participant. Workers have separate ContextTrees and share only the session-scoped agent inbox.

zh.name: 启动子代理
zh.description: 创建独立代理会话，复制初始上下文并交付指定子任务。

en.name: Submit Goal result
en.description: Submit the current Goal result and evidence to an independent reviewer. This does not declare completion by itself.

zh.name: 提交目标结果
zh.description: 将当前目标结果与证据提交给独立审查 Agent，本操作不会自行宣布完成。

en.name: Submit plan
en.description: Submit the current execution plan for user review.

zh.name: 提交计划
zh.description: 提交当前执行计划供用户审核。

en.name: Tool capability catalog
en.description: Gateway to deferred Plugins. Use list to inspect every current Plugin pack and standalone tool, describe to load current input schemas, and invoke to execute a Plugin.

zh.name: 工具能力目录
zh.description: 列出延迟加载的 Plugin、读取当前输入结构并调用指定 Plugin。

en.name: Track user data
en.description: Create durable user data for a task, project, decision, fact, or other entity.

zh.name: 追踪用户数据
zh.description: 创建任务、项目、决定、事实等持久用户数据。

en.name: Learn project memory
en.description: Main agent only. Queue an asynchronous project Memory Agent after durable evidence is complete. Use for an explicit user correction or preference, a recurring project-specific habit, completed project work or decision, a reusable success, or an understood failure and recovery. Do not pass memory content; the learner receives the exact current model context. Do not use for transient or unfinished details.

zh.name: 学习项目记忆
zh.description: 在证据完整后异步排队项目记忆学习。

en.name: Update user data
en.description: Update one field of a durable user-data entity.

zh.name: 更新用户数据
zh.description: 更新一个持久用户数据事务的指定字段。

en.name: Update plan progress
en.description: Main agent only. Update the durable Workbench plan before and after executing a plan step so the user can see exactly which step is active. This reloads the authoritative plan file every time and returns the latest step instructions. Call it immediately before starting every step and follow the returned title, description, command, files, and prerequisites. Use only when an approved plan is being executed.

zh.name: 更新计划进度
zh.description: 在执行前后更新持久 Workbench 计划的步骤状态。

en.name: Use tools
en.description: Enter the execution phase when the user's request requires tools.

zh.name: 调用工具
zh.description: 当用户请求需要工具时进入执行阶段。
